title: TOTU Stainless Steel Mens Womens Necklace Link Curb Chain Necklace with Bracelet , 10mm Width, 24”/8.5” Length
review:
Strong, sturdy, high quality jewelry. As much as I am surprised at the quality for the cost, I am extremely impressed with these products! For years I wore a very expensive silver necklace and matching bracelet, but they eventually wore down after everyday use, and I just never got around to buying another pair. Also, the cost was too high for my desire to replace them. Although I received this product at a discount, in exchange for my honest review, I can honestly say in comparison to the expensive jewelry I've owned, they've been more than I could have hoped for. PRODUCT: The necklace and chain are identical, so they match perfectly. They are both made of very strong stainless steel, but they're not extremely heavy, (which is a huge plus) and the quality is fantastic. It's clear that these are not only made to look great, but they're also meant to last. The clasp is thicker than most bracelet/necklace clasps, so no worries about that piece breaking or falling apart. Also, because it's made of stainless steel, most people with reactions to metal or metal allergies will be able to wear the product without having to worry about the consequences. PERSONALLY: I have about a 17" neck, and the necklace hangs down exactly where I'd prefer it to. The bracelet also fits me perfectly. I personally like a loose fit, that slides an inch or two, but not too loose that it can slide over my hand. I've had issues with bracelets that snag on things or slide up and down my arm too much. This bracelet does not do that with me. I look forward to showing these off, and wearing them quite often.

title: Yecan Women's Cotton Flower Petal Scarf Green
review:
Beautiful scarf! I am very pleased :)

A nice scarf. Only issues are that it needs to be washed before 1st wear (stiff, wrinkles, etc... ) and that the colors are quite a bit darker than the image here. title: My Wardrobe Women's Elegant Geometric Print Drape Front Knit Cardigan (XL, Purple)
review:
This item goes to the model's knees in the photo. In reality, it goes to just below the belt buckle. I wasn't expecting anything TOO nice for the price, but I was disappointed in the length. It is a vey thin shirt like material. Not a sweater at all. I'll wear it, but it might be a deal breaker for others. I read all the reviews and ordered a larger size and it was still almost to small. But I have washed it and the colors and size did not change. I was disappointed in this cardigan. The colors were off and it had way more of a southwest look then I expected. It was also shorter then it shows as well as ran small.
 The Geometric Print Drape is light-weight, comfortable and surprisingly true to size! The cut of the drape of the opening makes it flattering for all body shapes. The cotton blend material makes the cardigan breathable and soft. I have washed this many times without seeing any "pilling" or threads coming off. It is absolutely adorable and looks great! Thanks for watching! This cardigan was purchased at a discount in return for this honest review! I fell in love with this sweater when I first layed eyes on it on my computer screen! It took about 3-4 weeks for it to get to my door since it came from China. As you also could already imagine, their sizes are smaller which in turn, leaves this running about a size too small. I normally can fit a large to extra large, I went with an XL because I wanted it to me a little loose like most XL's are for me. This fits like a rather tight large. I am a bustier female as well, an it doesn't sit too well on my chest which leaves an unflattering look. HOWEVER I gave it to my daughter, and it looks great on her! We both agree it really compliments her. The colors are exactly as described and shown (I ordered purple) and they are vibrant and bold, The material is sort of thin so don't expect to keep very warm with it on in the winter, this is more of a fall suitable cardigan, well here in MI it is anyway. The only reason I gave 4 star instead of 5 is because I really wish it would have been true to size, then I could have kept it for myself and not had to give it to my daughter. **I received this at a discount in exchange for my honest review**
